# STEREO Webinar

> An agent skill that turns a long, messy stream or webinar recording into one clean video.
> It splits the recording into numbered CLEAN and TRASH pieces with boundaries in the pauses
> between words, lets a human review them by renaming files, shows frames of every clean
> piece to catch secrets the transcript cannot see, blurs them, and glues the approved pieces
> from the original at full quality — optionally a few percent faster.

The point of the project: junk in a live recording is recognised by meaning ("I'll be quiet,
you'll cut this"), not by loudness; and what must be hidden is on the screen, not in the audio.

## Start here

- [SKILL.md](SKILL.md): the sequence an agent follows, and where it must stop and ask.
- [README.md](README.md): numbers from a real 39-minute stream and why each step works the way it does.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules that are not visible from the code.

## Tools

- [tools/transcribe.py](tools/transcribe.py): speech → segments with per-word timings (STEREO Dictator API).
- [tools/webinar.py](tools/webinar.py): `lenta` (readable timeline), `cut` (drafts named NNN_ЧИСТ/МУСОР), `sheet` (frames of clean pieces), `glue` (from the original, with blur, speed, single-piece preview).

## Optional

- [.env.example](.env.example): the only configuration. Token comes from `/app` in @stereo_dictator_bot.
